item.text: MongoDB and Redis already use the field helpers for object reads. PostgreSQL has separate read queries, and its empty field list currently produces `null` instead of the full object. I’m aligning those paths and checking how the callback test mock handles optional arguments.

item.text: The existing field-helper tests require missing keys with selected fields to return an object whose requested fields are `null`. The new `getObject` and `getObjects` contract requires missing keys to be falsy. I’ll keep the helper behavior for existing callers and have the wrappers preserve missing-key status while using the same retrieval path.

item.text:
Updated `getObject` and `getObjects` across MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis to accept optional field names. An empty or omitted `fields` array returns the full object, including through `getObjectFields` and `getObjectsFields`. Selected fields include `null` for absent fields; object reads return `null` for missing keys, and bulk reads preserve input order.

Added coverage in [hash.js](/app/test/database/hash.js). The Redis hash suite passed **60 tests**, and ESLint and `git diff --check` passed. MongoDB and PostgreSQL integration tests were not run because those services were unavailable.
